findings.headline: Keep usePortalRoot optional: useContext(PortalContext) now throws outside a Provider instead of returning undefined.
findings.why: PortalContext is created without a default, and usePortalRoot returns useContext(PortalContext) as is, declaring GetContainer | undefined, so code outside a Provider relies on getting undefined. Solid 1.x returned undefined from useContext outside a Provider; Solid 2.0.3 throws ContextNotFoundError instead.
findings.guidance: Give the context an explicit empty value, createContext<T | null>(null), and map it back in the hook: return useContext(PortalContext) ?? undefined, so callers keep their contract. undefined is never a context value in Solid 2, so createContext<T | undefined>(undefined) still throws. If every caller is always inside a Provider, drop undefined from the hook's type instead.
